description: workflow/04b_maternal.smk: the duplicated rows of the Maternal Health Risk data (experiment C). The data file of experiment C (data/real/maternal.csv) is not changed; two derived files are written to data/derived/. Background, definitions and the recommendation: docs/maternal_duplicates.md.

definitions.identical record: rows equal in all six features and in the class label
definitions.identical features: rows equal in all six features, whatever the label
definitions.conflicting group: a set of rows with identical features that carries more than one class label

maternal_grouped.folds: sklearn StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits = 5, shuffle = True, random_state = seed); group = identical features, so no feature vector occurs in more than one fold

maternal_dedup.rows: first occurrence of every identical record (rows with identical features and different labels are all kept)
maternal_dedup.folds: as maternal_grouped, on the remaining rows

criteria.group integrity: in both derived files no feature vector occurs in more than one fold (0 groups split)
criteria.row counts: maternal_grouped has the rows of the source in the same order; maternal_dedup has exactly one row per identical record
criteria.separation: the separation rule of config/04_real_data.json holds for both derived files
criteria.parity: linear jobs: multinomial class of the job file (1e-3), as in experiment C; rand_forest: reported only
